theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_pw_noi_restrict_eq_of_smooth_test
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid n)), IsOpen U → IsFiniteMeasure μ → IsFiniteMeasure ν → (∀ b : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ U → ∫ y, b y ∂μ = ∫ y, b y ∂ν) → μ.restrict U = ν.restrict U
